title: validation.sh verdict
description: The single JSON object on the last line of stdout from validation.sh. The process exit code decides acceptance; this object explains it.

ok.description: Whether the submission satisfied the problem. Must agree with the exit code: true with exit 0, false with a non-zero exit. A disagreement is an authoring bug and yields IE.

message.description: Why the submission failed, in the learner's terms. Required when ok is false. Name what is wrong, not how to fix it.

testcase.description: 1-based index of the check that failed, for problems that run several.
